description.value: Sunset Waterfront Resort is a full-service condo-style resort on Okanagan Lake offering self-contained suites in both tower and townhouse formats, each with full kitchens, in-suite laundry, air conditioning, and a private BBQ patio. The complex features indoor and outdoor pools, hot tubs, a steam room, fitness centre, and tennis court, with a public boat launch directly across the street and boat moorage out front. The waterfront location puts cyclists within easy reach of Stuart Park, the Kelowna Yacht Club, and downtown's restaurants and entertainment venues.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Sunset Waterfront Resort is an active, bookable resort property at 1128 Sunset Dr, Kelowna, with phone 250-860-7368 matching OSM. In-suite laundry and wireless high-speed internet are explicitly stated on the resort page. No mention of bike storage, bike-handling procedures, drying areas, e-bike charging, or any other cycling-specific amenity appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: The contact page notes the management company (DKRA) relocated its office to 1610 Innovation Drive, Suite #2 effective June 1 2025; this is the operator's office address, not the resort address, which remains 1128 Sunset Dr.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable resort property with a confirmed address and web presence; useful accommodation stop for touring cyclists in Kelowna.

Laundry.detail: In-suite laundry facilities confirmed: "in-suite laundry facilities" and "washer and dryer and laundry supplies" stated on resort page

wow_evidence: indoor and outdoor pools, hot tubs, a steam room … waterfront location on Okanagan Lake

price.label: Upscale
price.signal: condo-style lakefront resort, full suites + pools; $220-320 shoulder
